- SC-003 (round-trip oracle re-imported prosaic's OWN forward output — the standing observation from prior iters): added 9 genuinely-foreign, hand-authored static fixture files (one per fully-invertible import-stable target) committed under conformance-fixtures/import-foreign/**, in each foreign tool's canonical on-disk form. Because the oracle is a committed file decoupled from the live serializer it catches serializer drift the self-referential conformance oracle cannot. New measured artifact test-results/import-roundtrip-foreign-sc003.json records oracle='hand-authored-foreign-file', totalSamples=9, byteIdentical=9, pass=true.
